connector.name: Callwright by topness.com
connector.registryDescription: Self-hosted MCP voice agent that places phone calls on your behalf via Retell.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package callwright. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.topness. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: RETELL_API_KEY
env.description: Your Retell secret API key (stays server-side)

env.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token clients must send; required when exposed beyond localhost

env.name: PORT
env.description: Port the HTTP MCP server listens on (default 8787)

env.name: CALLWRIGHT_DATA_DIR
env.description: Persistent directory for runtime state such as trigger deduplication

env.name: CALLWRIGHT_PUBLIC_URL
env.description: Public Callwright base URL used to configure Retell webhook delivery

env.name: CLAUDE_ROUTINE_URL
env.description: Optional complete Claude cloud Routine /fire endpoint URL

env.name: CLAUDE_ROUTINE_TOKEN
env.description: Optional dedicated bearer token for the configured Claude Routine trigger
